title: zephyranthes minor
intro: Zephyranthes minor, commonly known as Fairy Lily or Pink Zephyr, is a type of flowering plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its delicate appearance, bearing funnel-shaped flowers in shades of pink and white. The Fairy Lily has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to aid in digestion and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
